text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer felt inferior to the likes 
of Mejiro McQueen, who had never run away 
and always worked hard, believing she 
couldn't face them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there are things only Mejiro 
Palmer, who ran away, possesses. The 
unbeatable friendship forged at the end of 
her escape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To fire up Mejiro Palmer right alongside 
her, Daitaku Helios decided to enter the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
